_doc: Contract table of a profession (GDD 4.5.6, 06) [balance]. Every dawn, if the board has room (data/market.json board), one contract comes from here: a client not on cooldown, an item with qty in [min, max], a minimum quality in min_quality_chance of them (one of min_qualities), a deadline in deadline_days from acceptance. pay = qty × price_sell(item, quality) × (1 + premium), fixed when posted. Done: reputation + reward_reputation, relation with the client + reward_relation. Failed (expired or abandoned): reputation + fail_reputation, relation + fail_relation, the client posts nothing for client_cooldown_days (1 year = 8 days).
